item.title: Signups are now being accepted online in COCOBA leagues
item.description: Cal Ripken President Mike Watts said signups are currently underway in Cal Ripken Minor, Major and Midget along with Junior Babe Ruth for the 2026 season.

item.title: COCOBA to offer spring training for players 13-15
item.description: Cooper County Baseball Association Junior League President Mike Watts said players 13-15 will now be able to train for the upcoming season, starting mid-April.

item.title: New Franklin picks up sweep against Pilot Grove in CAC
item.description: The New Franklin boys’ and girls’ basketball teams picked up two big wins Tuesday night at home by beating the Pilot Grove Tigers in CAC action by the scores of 63-34 and 63-22, respectively.

item.title: Lady Pirates struggle early in 69-55 loss against Hickman
item.description: The Boonville Lady Pirates basketball team had one of those games Tuesday night against the Hickman Kewpies in Columbia.

item.title: Ganaway, Viertel power Pirates to win over Versailles
item.description: Boonville Pirates basketball coach Mark Anderson said after Tuesday’s 63-54 win over the Versailles Tigers-at this time of the year a win is a win.

item.title: Time capsule items being requested from residents
item.description: The Boonville High School classes of 1976 and 2026 are partnering together to create a time capsule to help celebrate the Semiquincentennial for the United States.
